moat_against: ROIC history is weak: roic_proxy negative FY2021-FY2024 (-5.55%, -13.09%, -9.88%, -3.48%), only +4.27% FY2025 and +15.5% FY2026 — no through-cycle proof
Narrow TAM: P&C core systems only; growth depends on a finite pool of large-carrier replacements and migrations
Credible challengers: Duck Creek (modular cloud), Sapiens (unified suite, mid-market/global), Majesco, plus SI-led modernization (Accenture/TCS/Infosys)
Long, services-heavy implementations — execution failures would erode the franchise faster than rival product gains
SBC remains heavy: $181,799,000 in FY2026, 12.3% of revenue — a real, recurring owner cost that caps owner's earnings
moat_for: InsuranceSuite is the enterprise benchmark for large North American P&C carriers — PolicyCenter/ClaimCenter/BillingCenter on Guidewire Cloud
Extreme switching costs: core-system replacements are multi-year, mission-critical programs
Gross ARR attrition under 1.5% in FY2026, under 1% for core-system customers; 105 customers above $5M fully-ramped ARR
Cloud ARR +35% in FY2026 to 84% of total ARR — installed base is migrating onto its own cloud, deepening lock-in
Expanding wallet share inside the base: PricingCenter (Nationwide as first US tier-1 customer) and ProNavigator (28 wins in FY2026)
moat_justification: Dominant P&C core platform (InsuranceSuite/Guidewire Cloud, 570+ insurers) with extreme switching costs — multi-year, mission-critical core replacements — and gross ARR attrition under 1.5% (under 1% for core customers) in FY2026. Capped at 6, not 7+: GAAP ROIC was negative through FY2024 and only inflected to +4.27% in FY2025 and +15.5% in FY2026 (fundamentals.json roic_proxy), so there is no through-cycle record of ROIC well above the cost of capital; the market is a narrow P&C-core niche contested by Duck Creek, Sapiens and Majesco, and long implementations carry execution risk.
name: Guidewire Software, Inc.
one_liner: High-quality P&C core franchise, moat 6/10, but priced far beyond owner's earnings — weighted IRR 4.88% and IV@15% $26.34 vs $168.86 price; clears 15% only below ~$26.
